title: Eyes-closed occipital alpha dominance, reproduced and replicated

dataset.name: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb)
dataset.citation: Schalk G, et al. BCI2000: a general-purpose brain-computer interface (BCI) system. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng. 2004;51(6):1034-43. Goldberger AL, et al. PhysioNet. Circulation. 2000;101(23):e215-20.

proposition: On eyes-closed baseline EEG, relative alpha power dominates every other band at the occipital electrode O1 (0.628) and replicates at Oz (0.596) — the classic Berger alpha rhythm — reproduced by the ecosystem with all five band-power claims GROUNDED and a byte-identical replay.

replication.note: Alpha again exceeds every other band at a second occipital electrode (H2 bundle, 5/5 GROUNDED).

open_questions.q: None: this is an established textbook finding (Berger 1929) used here to demonstrate reproducible spectral analysis on public EEG. Escalation is reserved for genuinely unresolved questions.
